贝飞达，由Schlechtendal.发表于1839年Synonyms :
异名：
Cotyledon bifida (Schlechtendal) Hemsley (1880)
Echeveria bifurcata Rose (1909)
Echeveria erubescens E. Walther (1972)
Echeveria tenuifolia E. Walther (1972)Series Angulatae
剑司系
Distribution : Mexico (Hidalgo, Queretaro?)
分布于墨西哥Hidalgo州和Queretaro州（持疑）
Description (according to IHSP 2003) :
描述（根据2003年IHSP）：Stem to 6 cm tall or more, ±1 – 1,5 cm in diameter, usually unbranched
茎部：6cm或更高，±1-1.5cm直径，茎部通常不分枝。Rosette 6 – 10 ( - 20 cm) in diameter.
莲座：6-10（-20）cm直径。Leaves lanceolate to rhomboid-oblanceolate, acuminate, mucronate, 4 -10 x 1 – 2,5 cm, upper face, concave to flat, green to purplish.
叶：披针形到菱形-倒披针形，渐尖，有短尖，4-10cm长，1-2.5cm宽，上表面下凹或平坦，绿色到淡紫色。Inflorescences single, to 3-branched cincinni, with 6 – 20 flowers, pedicels 1 – 4 (- 8) mm.
花序：独生，较多有3根蝎尾状分枝，6-20朵花，花梗1-4（-8）mm。Flowers : Sepals to 15 mm, subterete to terete, spreading to reflexed, corolla 12 – 17 x 9 – 11 mm in diameter at the base, 4 mm in diameter at the mouth, reddish or yellowish below, reddish above.
花：萼片可达15mm，半圆柱型到圆柱形，张开或反折；花冠12-17mm高，基部9-11mm直径，顶部4mm直径；基部淡红色或淡黄色，顶部发红。Cytology : n = 12
染色体：n=12
Although Walther (1972) recognized 3 other species distinct from E. bifida, all have the same chromosome number and differ in such minor details as stem length, the concavity of the upper leaf face, number of inflorescences branches and length of the pedicels. They all seem better reduced under E. bifida.
尽管Walther曾认为有三种与贝飞达不同的物种（译者注：即Echeveria bifurcata、Echeveria erubescens、Echeveria tenuifolia ，但它们的染色体数目全都相同，且四者之间的差异非常细微，比如茎部的长度、上表面的下凹程度、花序上的分枝数目和花梗的长度。因此，其他三种较好也都归于贝飞达名下。
Note :
请注意：The flower photo Fig. 39 in Pilbeam "Echeveria", p. 60, by B. Kemble, is misleading : The flower of E. bifurcata (synonym of E. bifida) is pale yellowish in the lower third to half – and not whitish – and pinkish to reddish above – not dark red.
Pilbeam的《Echeveria》一书中第60页上第39幅插图（by B. Kemble）很具有误导性：E. bifurcata（贝飞达的异名）的花下半部分应该是淡黄色的，不是白色，上部应该是淡粉色至淡红色的，不是深红色。
